results.name: Borussia Dortmund at Arsenal
results.headline: Arsenal dropped points from a winning position for the second time in as many games following a 1-1 draw with Borussia Dortmund at the Emirates Stadium on Tuesday.

results.name: PSV Eindhoven at Real Madrid
results.headline: A long-range stunner from Jude Bellingham and Kylian Mbappé's double powered Real Madrid past PSV Eindhoven 5-1 for their fifth straight Champions League victory.

results.name: Napoli at Manchester City
results.headline: Rayan Cherki scored a fine late equalizer as Manchester City snatched a 2-2 draw against Napoli in the Champions League.

results.name: Aston Villa at Galatasaray
results.headline: Aston Villa's hopes of earning automatic Champions League qualification took a blow after they were beaten 1-0 at Galatasaray on Tuesday.

results.name: Everton at Brentford
results.headline: Vitaly Janelt scored a 30-yard screamer as Brentford romped to a 4-0 victory against 10-man Everton at the Gtech Community Stadium.

results.name: Atlético Madrid at Getafe
results.headline: Atlético Madrid bolstered their spot in third in LaLiga with a comfortable 3-0 win at Getafe on Sunday.

results.name: Frosinone at AC Milan
results.headline: AC Milan racked up their biggest win of the season under Ruben Amorim as Frosinone were beaten 5-1 at San Siro on Sunday.

results.name: Manchester United at Liverpool
results.headline: Mauricio Pochettino's Manchester United reign got off to a miserable start as Liverpool punished Leny Yoro's red card with a pair of early goals on their way to a comprehensive 4-0 win against their relegation-threatened rivals.

results.name: Fortuna Sittard at Go Ahead Eagles
Brighton & Hove Albion at Hull City
results.headline: Hull pounced at the death as Oli McBurnie struck twice in added time to snatch a 2-0 victory against high-flying Brighton at the MKM Stadium.

results.name: ADO Den Haag at Ajax Amsterdam
Villarreal at Barcelona
results.headline: Barcelona restored their three-point lead at the top of LaLiga with a stunning second-half comeback against Villarreal at the Nou Camp.
